annotations.title: Bridge coverage: what cross-chain tracing covers

description: What ASPERN’s cross-chain tracing covers, exactly, and what it does not. Circle CCTP V2, USDC, among 24 EVM networks in every direction (552 routes; stored index and on demand; the first four since 2026-11-23/24, twenty more since 2026-11-24), and since 2026-11-24 Across V3, LayerZero OFT / Stargate V2 and Wormhole (Token Bridge, NTT), any token, from and to the same four networks, one source transaction at a time on demand (`bridges`: per bridge the link, source and destination events, contracts, the price source, the 24 h volumes measured on 2026-11-24, limits). Not covered: CCTP V1, CCIP, native rollup bridges and every other bridge, destinations outside the four (decoded and named, not read), history or market share for the three on-demand bridges, hooks after delivery, ownership, AI involvement or autonomy. With network and/or protocol (cctp, across, layerzero, stargate, wormhole, ntt …), says whether that pair is covered; outside it, absence of a trace says nothing about activity there. FREE.

network.description: Optional: a network to ask about (base, ethereum, hyperevm, polygon, or any other name).

protocol.description: Optional: a protocol to ask about (cctp, across, layerzero, stargate, wormhole, ntt, ccip …).

name: bridge_coverage

asked.description: The network and protocol asked about, null where not asked.

bridges.description: Since 2026-11-24, the bridges traced on demand: per bridge (across, layerzero, wormhole) versions, link, source and destination events; networks; contracts; priceSource; sources; measured24h (transfers and USD a day per bridge, all destinations and among the four); notClaimed; limits.

contracts.description: TokenMessengerV2, MessageTransmitterV2, TokenMinterV2, MessageV2 (the same address on every network covered).

inCoverage.description: Whether the asked pair is inside the pilot; null when nothing was asked.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

networks.description: network, CCTP domain id, label and since (the day the index began reading it).

notClaimed.description: What no trace establishes: same owner, an AI agent, autonomy, same coins.

notCovered.description: What it does not read: other bridges, other domains, history, hooks, reorgs, ownership.

pilot.description: True: a pilot, not a product-wide index.

protocol.description: The one protocol traced: Circle CCTP V2.

rateLimit.description: Circle Iris’ published limit and how we stay under it.

routes.description: Directions traced: every ordered pair of the networks (552 routes, e.g. base->ethereum, arbitrum->hyperevm).

sources.description: Where each step is read from: the source and destination chains, Circle Iris v2, our vault flows.

statuses.description: The statuses a message can carry, only what the protocol evidences.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Bridge coverage: what cross-chain tracing covers
